title: RespFocus: Learning Temporal Evidence for Weakly Supervised Respiratory Sound Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.15702v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Respiratory auscultation provides a low-cost means of assessing pulmonary function, yet transient crackles and sustained wheezes can be difficult to recognize in noisy clinical recordings. Conventional deep learning classifiers often operate as black boxes, offering limited insight into the temporal acoustic evidence supporting their predictions. We present RespFocus, a weakly supervised framework that uses multiple instance learning (MIL) to learn inspectable temporal evidence from cycle-level labels and integrate it into classification. We also introduce PedResp2026, a multicenter pediatric respiratory sound cohort collected in routine clinical environments with adjudicated cycle-level annotations. In classification experiments, RespFocus achieves four-class Scores of 69.55\% on public ICBHI 2017 and 72.91\% on PedResp2026. translated_title: RespFocus：为弱监督呼吸音分类学习时间证据
translated_abstract: 呼吸听诊是一种评估肺功能的低成本手段，然而短暂的爆裂音和持续的喘鸣音在嘈杂的临床录音中往往难以识别。传统的深度学习分类器通常作为黑箱运行，对于支持其预测的时间声学证据提供的洞察十分有限。我们提出了RespFocus，这是一个弱监督框架，它利用多示例学习（MIL）从周期级标签中学习可检查的时间证据，并将其整合到分类中。我们还介绍了PedResp2026，这是一个在常规临床环境中收集的多中心儿科呼吸音队列，带有经过裁定的周期级标注。在分类实验中，RespFocus在公开的ICBHI 2017数据集上取得了69.55%的四分类得分，在PedResp2026上取得了72.91%。证据诊断和匹配的时间干预实验支持了所学证据的功能性贡献。
tldr: 提出弱监督框架RespFocus，利用多示例学习从周期级标签中学习可解释的时间声学证据用于呼吸音分类，并在ICBHI 2017和新发布的多中心儿科数据集PedResp2026上分别取得69.55%和72.91%的四分类得分。
